_comment: Literals accepted by no-hardcoded-strings.mjs without t(). Matched on the exact text in any in-scope file. Every entry needs a reason. Prefer t() or a `// i18n-ignore: <reason>` comment at the site; add an entry here only for text that is the same in every language or cannot be translated where it renders. BASELINE DEBT entries are pre-t32 untranslated copy that the t32 i18n pass removes; delete an entry once its text is gone (the script lists unused entries).
